verdict.rationale: Smooth's CLI docs have a dedicated files feature page stating the agent can work with files in both directions: you give it files to upload to websites, and it downloads files from the web for you. That covers the core upload and download story. missing for 10: details on how downloaded artifacts are stored and retrieved after a session (API or CLI retrieval, retention), equivalent documentation for the REST API/SDK path, independent or hands-on corroboration.
